open-ani/animeko.body:
- 新增画质增强(超分)，支持 Android, Windows 和 macOS (#3291 by @black4der)
- 新增在线源查询缓存，有缓存时跳过查源步骤，大幅加速开播速度
- 播放页新增一起看入口，全屏时隐藏悬浮窗
- 优化评论功能和 UI
- 支持使用 PikPak 加速缓存 BT 源 (#3141 by @NihilDigit)
- 新缓存管理页面

----

- 条目详情页封面与角色/制作人员图片支持点击放大查看
- 修复 Windows mpv 画面偏暗
- 支持鼠标侧键返回上一页
- 支持 mpv 内核播放器设置自定义参数
- 优化 jellyfin (#3190 by @jxing7036, #3244, #3248 by @IT-BillDeng)
- 修复 Windows 原生触屏一系列问题 (#3223, #3234 by @NihilDigit)
- 修复 Windows 10 可能会窗口透明 (#3319 by @myouo)
- 优化性能 (#3236 by @NihilDigit)
- 修复 macOS x86 无法打开或闪退
- 修复 macOS 可能因为音频而崩溃
- 修复 BT 源播放错误或无法开始播放 (#3337 by @GrahamZen)
- 支持为 BT 下载设置额外的 trackers
- 修复桌面端图片比较糊
- 修复一系列 Linux 问题 (#3261 by @NihilDigit)
- 修复手动匹配的弹幕请求会随着换集失效 (#3254 by @GrahamZen)
- 优化数据源管理页长按批量编辑功能
- 修复条目详情页的剧集卡片无法长按标记看过
- 修复条目详情页 Tab 换行问题 (#3229 by @arpitagarwal1301)
- 修复 Windows 托盘状态下再次启动会卡死 (#3317 by @Tantless)
- 修复播放器倍速状态与 UI 不一致 (#3323 by @SXP-Simon)
- 新增数据源工作原理示意动画
- 为 macOS 暂时禁用 Accessibility 以修复闪退 (#3325 by @black4der)
- 支持配置 ExoPlayer 的画质增强预热，解决黑屏或系统增强功能失效
- 新增开源许可页面，可在设置 - 关于 - 鸣谢中查看
- 修复异常指纹过滤默认生效且关闭开关无效的问题 (#3338 by @GrahamZen)
- 修复 BT 缓存统计不准确 (#3339 by @GrahamZen)
- Android 修复 WebView 正常无法释放 (#3340 by @GrahamZen)
- 修复 Toast 配色没有跟随应用主题 (#3347 by @GrahamZen)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-ani/animeko/compare/v6.0.0...v6.1.0

open-ani/animeko.name: 5.0.0-alpha02
open-ani/animeko.body:
Animeko 5.0 测试版发布

## 新账号系统

Animeko 5.0 将使用新的账号系统。现在通过 Animeko 账号即可收藏番剧条目并跨平台同步，无需强制注册 Bangumi 账号。
Bangumi 账号变更为“第三方账号”，与你的 Animeko 账号绑定。绑定成功后即可支持将 Animeko 账号的收藏数据与 Bangumi 账号的收藏数据进行双向同步。

对于从 4.x 升级并通过登录 Bangumi 账号的用户，升级后需要重新通过 Bangumi oAuth 授权登录来继承旧版账号发送的弹幕等数据，另外需要绑定一个邮箱来支持邮箱登录；新用户可以通过邮箱或者 Bangumi oAuth 授权登录两种方式注册新的 Animeko 账号。

## 其他变更

* 优化播放页的评论和弹幕设置 UI
* 修复进入缓存页可能无法显示缓存列表
* 禁用 VLC 可能导致冲突的内置键盘快捷键 (#2247 by @Koileo)
* 修复搜索页过滤可能会出现空位 (#2299 by @GeneralK1ng)
* 修复数据源播放失败后会再次选择失败的数据源
* 修复 Android 端无法使用第三方软件包安装程序安装更新 (#2317 by @aaa1115910)
* 修复数据源手动编辑查询请求时无法舍弃编辑
* 修复条目详情页剧集列表长按设置已看功能失效

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-ani/animeko/compare/v4.11.1...v5.0.0-alpha02

EhPanda-Team/EhPanda.name: [v3.0.0] Features, Bugfixes and Refactoring
EhPanda-Team/EhPanda.body:
## Features

- **Offline downloads.** Save galleries to your device and read them with no connection. Sort them into folders, and let the app repair a download that got interrupted or update it later. Downloads keep going while the app is in the background and won't get cut off partway.
- **Date Seek.** Jump straight to a specific date while paging through a gallery. It works on the Frontpage, Watched and Favorites lists.
- **WebP images** are now supported.
- **Redesigned toasts.** Progress and status messages (login, page jump, background updates, and more) now show as a sleek glass toast at the bottom of the screen instead of a pop-up spinner.

## Bugfixes

- The page slider and the current page no longer drift out of sync
- Fixed a gesture problem in the reading control panel
- Fixed a crash on the EH settings page
- Fixed the missing toolbar item on the reading settings page
- Fixed an empty cell in quick search
- Fixed layout issues on the tags extension settings, the About page, and gallery cells in other languages
- Fixed the search title disappearing
- Fixed two settings pages opening at once on iPad
- Fixed page tracking and zoom boundaries while reading

## Refactoring

Plenty changed under the hood. The app now targets iOS 26 and was rebuilt on Apple's latest frameworks for smoother performance and fewer bugs down the road. Downloads moved to a new storage system that's faster and more reliable. Navigation was rebuilt on Apple's modern stack-based APIs, and several third-party dependencies (AlertKit, TTProgressHUD, FilePicker, SwiftUINavigation) were dropped in favor of native equivalents. We also reworked the reading view and rewrote the test suite to keep future updates stable.

Kyosee/VeneraX.name: v2.3.1
Kyosee/VeneraX.body:
> **Language / 语言**: [English](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/blob/v2.3.1/release-notes/v2.3.1.en.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/blob/v2.3.1/release-notes/v2.3.1.zh-CN.md)

## What's Changed

### Added
- Follow Updates can now follow several favorite folders at once, or every folder including ones you add later
- New Follow Updates settings: how often a comic is re-checked, whether to check right after the app starts, and a daily time before which automatic checks wait
- The Follow Updates page now shows a status strip with the followed scope, comic and update counts, and the time of the last check
- Comic details now show a Reading sources section, so you can see which other sources carry the same comic and link or unlink them
- The source selector on the Explore and Categories pages now has a search box for finding a source by name

### Changed
- Opening the Follow Updates page and refreshing it are noticeably faster on a large library

### Fixed
- Source lists and scripts on a private host can now be saved and updated: addresses carrying `user:password@host` credentials, a host without a dot such as `localhost`, and IPv6 addresses are all accepted
- Fixed installing a source script whose file name carries a query, which previously failed to install
- Fixed the Follow Updates page not opening on a device where no folder is followed yet

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1

### Added
- Page jump dialog now shows maximum page count and automatically clamps input to valid range
